result.topic_en: A numbered list of knots in English (fisher's/water knot, meshing knot, barber's knot, bowline knot, wale knot) with sketches, followed by bibliographic references to Riedl's work on the theory of chord angles and to 's Gravesande's Philosophiae Newtonianae.
